content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-poaching restriction exists anywhere in the agreement — this matches our preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce" and "recruit" across the single-section agreement return no restrictive covenant on hiring or soliciting personnel; the only employment-related language is the independent-contractor provision (p0066), indemnity references to persons "hired by, employed, retained" (p0051, p0052) and confidentiality handling by employees (p0056, p0061). No non-solicitation or no-hire obligation binds the Customer (AP), which is the playbook's preferred position, so no edit is required.
